name: homelab-status
description: A live, self-hosted control room for your home lab: machines, services, maps, a wall screen, one-click updates and failover. Zero dependencies.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs demo/demo.mjs examples/*.mjs public/*.js scripts/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile reporters/*.py && echo all good
